name: EMP Metals Corp.
summary: EMP Metals Corp. is primarily involved in the identification, assessment, exploration, and development of mineral properties. Its main focus lies in uncovering gold and silver deposits. The company's asset portfolio encompasses sites in New South Wales, Australia, along with lithium brine properties in Saskatchewan. Established in 2018, the firm operated as Sentinel Resources Corp. before officially changing its name to EMP Metals Corp. in November 2021. Its corporate headquarters are located in North Vancouver, Canada.
